item.title: Git Bash and WSL on Windows Terminal Preview vs IntelliJ
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: For some reason IntelliJ and Windows terminal discover available shells in different ways, but either way is not ideal. (In-fact IntelliJ uses two different means of discovery.) The terminal popup in Intellj seems to be unaware of Gitbash.. Which is in complete contrast to the terminal settings (same plugin) which is unaware of my WSL deployments. (Possibly because it’s using a file path based system) Which means I can’t set Debian WSL as my default terminal in IntelliJ.

item.title: Lenovo, Ubuntu Upgrade, and the Backport Iwlwifi Dkms Package
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: Had an issue with getting MOK to install my keys for my Intel Corporation Wi-Fi 6 AX200 (rev 1a) wireless card on my Lenovo X1 Carbon Extreme G2.. Turns out there is a bug in the shell script that installs the self signed keys in to MOX… Which is great. But it turns out I have hit a bug.. Perhaps this is because I use zsh or some other reason but.

item.title: Akregator Doesn't Work on KDE's Blog
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: Small gripe.. But it seems that with a default install of KDE it the Akregator (RSS feed reader) comes pre configured with the KDE blog which doesn’t render correctly. -_- Not that it matters it seems there isn’t any syncing ability in Akregator meaning I will stick with Miniflux for now.
